---
title: "Second-factor Attempts"
description: "Second-factor outcomes at sign-in, successful or failed, in a reporting period."
---

The number of times someone presented a second factor at sign-in over a selected
reporting period, whether it succeeded or failed.

An attempt is an outcome: a code entered, right or wrong, or a passkey prompt
that succeeded or failed. A code that was sent and never entered is not an
attempt; it is still a [challenge](mfa-challenges.qmd). This is the denominator
of [MFA Success Rate](mfa-success-rate.qmd), so the two always agree.

It covers the factors the public can sign in with: `sms_otp`, `voice_otp`, and
`fido2` (passkeys). `email_otp` checks an email address at sign-up and is not a
second factor, and `kq`, `totp`, `qr`, and `ibm_verify_push` are internal.

## Calculation

Restrict to the sign-in factors and to the `success` and `failure` rows, then sum
`count`. Leave out `sent` rows: they are issued codes, not outcomes.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Example queries"}

::: {.panel-tabset}

## SQL

```sql
SELECT
    SUM(count) AS second_factor_attempts
FROM ibm_verify_events_transformed.events_mfa_activity
-- set the reporting window; see the timespans note in cookbook/notes.qmd
WHERE CAST(from_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-05-28'
  -- the factors the public can sign in with; email_otp is a sign-up check
  AND mfa_type IN ('sms_otp', 'voice_otp', 'fido2')
  -- outcomes only; a "sent" row is a code issued, not an attempt
  AND result IN ('success', 'failure');
```

## R

```r
tbl(con, in_schema("ibm_verify_events_transformed", "events_mfa_activity")) |>
  # set the reporting window; see the timespans note in cookbook/notes.qmd
  filter(
    as.Date(from_date) >= as.Date("2026-01-01"),
    as.Date(from_date) <= as.Date("2026-05-28"),
    # the factors the public can sign in with; email_otp is a sign-up check
    mfa_type %in% c("sms_otp", "voice_otp", "fido2"),
    # outcomes only; a "sent" row is a code issued, not an attempt
    result %in% c("success", "failure")
  ) |>
  summarise(
    second_factor_attempts = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

:::

:::

## Interpretation notes

Attempts count tries, not people: someone who mistypes a code twice and then gets
it right makes three attempts. Failed attempts are attempts less successes. For
the codes issued, whether or not anyone entered them, use [MFA
Challenges](mfa-challenges.qmd).

## Alternative names

- MFA attempts
- second-factor outcomes
- sign-in MFA attempts
